Animals.title: Animals
Animals.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}} [[File:Chicken.png|200px|left]] '''Animals''' are a central feature of [[Hay Day]]. There are three types of animals in the game: farm animals, which produce [[Animal Goods|goods]] needed to make many other [[products]]; [[:Category:Pets|pets]] and [[:Category:Sanctuary Animals|wild animals]], which give [[experience]] points and [[supplies]]; and finally, animals which give life to the game but do not have any other function. {{Clr}} ---- ==='''Farm animals'''=== Farm animals live on the [[farm]] and in the [[Fishing Lake|fishing lake]]. Farm animals are bought in the [[shop]] using [[coin]]s and must be put into [[:Category:Animal Shelters|shelters]] while [[Fishing Lake|fishing lake]] animals must be caught. Сub.png|link=Panda|Brown panda cub Brown Rhino.png|link=Rhinoceros|Brown rhino Grey Rhino.png|link=Rhinoceros|Grey rhino ---- ==='''Decorative animals'''=== Decorative animals populate all the playable areas. Players can interact with most animals by tapping on them. Most make sounds and move when this happens. Some [[decorations]] such as flowers, bird houses and ponds attract butterflies, birds and frogs. Ravens can have its feathers flicked away when flying. Foxes tend to hang around [[Trees_and_Bushes|bushes]]. Seagulls appear when a [[fishing]] spot is in cooldown time. The neighborhood building has a mouse hole in its lower left corner. A mouse can be seen peering out from it at regular intervals. Dragonflies appear at the Fishing Lake, Fishes can be found by tapping the water. However, some water does not contain fishes. ---- ==='''Thematic changes'''=== {{Main|Themes}} *As themes change, some animals change as well (e.g. for Halloween, birds turn into bats). *Some farm animals also get temporary accessories. ---- ==='''Tips'''=== As of January 2026: *There are 84 pets in game, which provide a total experience of 4010 if all pets are awaken at once. *In the case for the Sanctuary, there are 52 animals available, and up to 1300 experience points. *The chances of getting an item are around 22% on most pets, with the exception of horses which are 29%, donkeys and sanctuary which are 9% each. *Vouchers required for all pets: Green 736 - Blue 854 - Purple 771 - Golden 338 - Chick 216. *In order to complete the Sanctuary to the recent update, 1872 Puzzles are required. *No [[Pickaxe|pickaxes]] can be obtained via pets or the Sanctuary. *For a list of most of the prizes available when you feed pets, see this table by MindoPod: [[User:MindoPod/Pet Rewards|Pet Rewards]]. ---- {{Navigation}} {{Languages |de = Tiere |es = Animales |fr = Les Animaux |it = Animali |no = Dyr |ru = Животные }} [[Category:Animals]]

BBQ Grill.title: BBQ Grill
BBQ Grill.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}} [[File:BBQ Grill.png|left|200px|BBQ Grill]] {{Infobox |title = [[Production Buildings|Machine]] |level = 9 |price = 730 |time = 8 h |slots = 2 |dia = 29 |size = 2×2 }} The '''BBQ Grill''' is a [[Production Buildings|production building]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 9. It is used to make [[Bacon and Eggs|bacon and eggs]], [[Baked Potato|baked potatoes]], [[Banana Pancakes|banana pancakes]], [[Fish and Chips|fish and chips]], [[Fish Burger|fish burgers]], [[Grilled Onion|grilled onions]], [[hamburger]]s, [[Lobster Skewer|lobster skewers]], [[pancake]]s, [[Fish Skewer|fish skewer]], [[Roasted Tomatoes|roasted tomatoes]], and [[Grilled Lamb Skewer|grilled lamb skewers]]. {{Clr}} ---- ==='''Appearance'''=== The BBQ Grill is a red grill with a metal framework. It sits on a wooden platform. Two bags of coal are next to it. A wooden table is in front of it. The mastered version gets a star on the side and some golden parts. ---- === '''Building''' === It costs 730 {{Infoicon|coin}} and takes 8 hours (or 29 {{Infoicon|dia}}) to build the BBQ Grill. Crops.title: Crops
Crops.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}} [[File:Wheat.png|200px|left]] '''Crops''' are plants players can cultivate on [[Farm|farm land]]. Some crops grow in [[Farm|fields]] while others grow on [[Trees and Bushes|trees or bushes]]. Crops are unlocked at [[experience]] level 1. Crops are stored in the [[silo]]. {{Clr}} ---- ==='''Cultivating crops'''=== [[File:Field.png|150px|left]] Players cultivate field crops by planting previously harvested crops into fields. One planted crop gives two harvested ones. When players unlock new types of plants they are given one to three plants to start up. Crop fields can be obtained by progress leveling up, in 2 or 3 levels. {{Clr}} [[File:Apple Tree.png|150px|left]] Players cultivate tree and bush crops by placing [[Trees and Bushes|trees or bushes]] on their farm. Trees and bushes die after several harvests and have to be regularly replaced with new ones. {{Clr}} Fields, trees and bushes are bought in the [[shop]] {{BigIcon|Shop Icon|point=Shop|size=50px}}. Fields cost 1 {{Infoicon|coin}} each. Trees and bushes cost between 160 to 910 {{Infoicon|coin}} per unit. Planting field crops does not cost any money. ---- ==='''Available crops'''=== For a much more comprehensive and detailed table '''see our [[Crops List]] for just crops, or see [[Goods List]] for all goods''' (not mobile-friendly). Products.title: Products
Products.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}}
[[File:Bread.png|200px|left|A product]]
'''Products''' are items made or collected from [[Production Buildings|production buildings]]. There are currently 350 products (June 2026) in the game (not including limited-time products).

All but [[lure]]s, [[Net Maker|nets and traps]] can be sold in the [[Roadside Shop|roadside shop]] for [[coin]]s. All but lures, nets, traps, ore, and feed let players fill [[truck]], [[boat]] and [[town]] orders and earn [[experience]] points.

Products are stored in the [[barn]] or the [[Tackle Box|tackle box]].

Salad Bar.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}} {{Infobox |title = [[Production Buildings|Machine]] |level = 58 |price = 165,000 |time = 2 d |slots = 2 |dia = 65 |size = 3×3 }}[[File:Salad Bar.png|200px|left]] The '''Salad Bar''' is a [[Production Buildings|production building]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 58. It is used to make [[Feta Salad|feta salad]], [[BLT Salad|BLT salad]], [[Seafood Salad|seafood salad]], [[Pasta Salad|pasta salad]], [[Veggie Platter|veggie platters]], [[Summer Rolls|summer rolls]], [[Fruit Salad|fruit salad]], [[Summer Salad|summer salad]] and[[Mushroom Salad| mushroom salad]]. {{Clr}}---- === '''Building''' === It costs 165,000 {{Infoicon|coin}} and takes 2 days (or 65 {{Infoicon|dia}}) to build the Salad Bar. It gives players 32 {{Infoicon|xp}} when completed. ---- === '''Products''' === {{Building Products |Feta Salad|58|1:30|745 |Bean Salad|58|1h|169 |BLT Salad|62|1:45|723 |Seafood Salad|64|2h|763 |Pasta Salad|67|2:30|759 |Veggie Platter|74|2h|266 |Coleslaw|75|1:15|468 |Beetroot Salad|76|45m|234 |Summer Rolls|78|1h|316 |Fruit Salad|82|2h|597 |Summer Salad|84|3h|554 |Mushroom Salad|89|1h|216 |Orange Salad|117|45m|558 }} ---- === '''Upgrading''' === {{Main|Production Buildings}} The Salad Bar originally has two slots available. Trees and Bushes.title: Trees and Bushes
Trees and Bushes.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}}
[[File:Apple Tree.png|200px|left]]
'''Trees and bushes''' are plants which let players collect [[Crops|fruit]] and nectar, shelter [[Honey Bee|honey bees]], and [[Decorations|decorate]] their farm.

Fruit plants are unlocked at [[experience]] level 15. Nectar bushes and the beehive tree are unlocked at level 39. Decorative trees are unlocked at level 1.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Fruit plants'''===
'''Fruit plants''' are either trees or bushes which let players collect various fruit. These trees and bushes grow in four stages and consequently only give four harvests. Players must wait a certain amount of time --from several hours to longer than a day depending on the plant-- between harvests to let the plant grow and produce fruit.

The first harvest gives two fruit, the second one three and the last two ones four.

After the third harvest the plant wilts and must be revived by another player (see below). After the last harvest, the plant dies. Players can cut down trees with [[Saw|saws]] and bushes with [[Axe|axes]].

==='''Nectar bushes and beehive tree'''===
{{Main|Nectar Bush}}
{{Main|Beehive Tree}}
[[File:Nectar Bush.png|125px|left|Nectar bush]]
[[File:Beehive Tree Stage 1.png|left|125px|Beehive Tree]]
'''[[Nectar Bush|Nectar bushes]]''' are used to let [[Honey Bee|honey bees]] collect nectar which they then bring to their beehives located in the '''[[Beehive Tree]]'''.

Players can have as many bushes as they want but, like fruit ones, these die once a bee has collected 250 drops of nectar from it. They can be revived once by other players and cut down with an [[axe]].

Unlike fruit plants they turn white when wilted or dead and some players use them as decorations.

Players can only have one beehive tree. This tree grows in four stages as bees bring more nectar to it. It never dies.

The Beehive Tree costs 4,000{{Infoicon|coin}} and each Nectar Bush costs 120{{Infoicon|coin}}.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Peanut bushes and squirrel house'''===
{{Main|Peanut Bush}}
{{Main|Squirrel House}}
[[File:Peanut Bush.png|125px|left|Peanut bush]]
[[File:Squirrel House Stage 4.png|left|125px|Squirrel House]]
'''[[Peanut Bush|Peanut bushes]]''' are used to let [[Squirrel|squirrels]] collect peanuts they then bring to their houses located in the '''[[Squirrel House]]'''.

Players can have as many bushes as they want but, like fruit ones, these die once a squirrel has collected 1,000 peanuts from it. They can be revived once by other players and cut down with an [[axe]].

Unlike fruit plants they turn white when wilted or dead and some players use them as decorations.

Players can only have one squirrel house. This tree grows in four stages as squirrels bring more peanuts to it. It never dies.

The Squirrel House costs 45,000{{Infoicon|coin}} and each Peanut Bush costs 1,200{{Infoicon|coin}}.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Decorative plants'''===
{{Main|Decorations}}
[[File:Heart Topiary.png|125px|left|Topiary]]
[[File:Leafy Tree.png|125px|left|Leafy tree]]
[[File:Rose Fence Red.png|125px|left|Rose fence]]
Players can decorate their [[farm]] and their [[town]] with various topiaries.

The game also lets players plant pine trees and leafy trees. They come in different sizes and leaf color. However, unlike trees present at the beginning of the game, they are never [[Themes|themed]].

Some decorative trees are only available during holidays such as the Christmas Tree and the Spider Tree.

Finally, bushes can be planted to create hedges.

Decorative plants do not have any growth cycle and never die.

Buying these decorations cost [[coin]]s, [[diamond]]s or [[voucher]]s and give players [[experience]] points.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Reviving a plant'''===
[[File:Tree Revival Stage 1.png|150px|left|Wilted tree]]
* When a tree or a bush is wilted players can tap on the help (!) sign to signal other players that it needs to be revived. Any player who visits the farm can revive the tree. The help sign is also displayed in the [[friends]] bar and in the [[Daily Dirt]] if the player is selling an item.

{{Clr}}
[[File:Tree Revival Stage 2.png|150px|left|Megaphone]]
* If connected to Facebook, players can use the "megaphone" to let their friends know they need help.

{{Clr}}
[[File:Tree Revival Stage 3.png|150px|left|Helped tree]]
*Once a player has helped, their avatar is displayed on the tree.

{{Clr}}
[[File:Tree Revival Stage 4.png|150px|left|Revived tree]]
*Players need to tap on the avatar to complete the revival process. An envelope then appears. Tapping on it sends a [[Gift Card|thank you note]] to the player who revived the plant.

{{Clr}}

Reviving a plant gives [[experience]] points to the player who revived it. It gives as many points as collecting a fruit from this plant does.

Players can opt not to have their plant revived and cut it down immediately.

Reviving wilted trees and bushes contributes to the 'Help' task in [[derby|derbies]].
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* If you are in a neighborhood, save trees and bushes which can be revived if a derby is ongoing or is soon starting to help farmers in your neighborhood complete the task of helping others quickly and thus gain many Derby Points.
* If you wish to get your tree or bush revived as soon as possible, put something up for sale in your shop and advertise it.
*Be careful about the number of trees and bushes you plant. You might find yourself unable to cut/ chop them down when dead because you don't have enough supplies. Not taking into account aesthetics, dead trees take up valuable space from your farm.

'''Apples''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 15. They grow on [[Apple Tree|apple trees]] and can be harvested four times, with each harvest giving varying numbers of apples. They are the first tree crop unlocked in the game.

They were added on July 12, 2012, along with [[Apple Juice]], [[Apple Pie]] and [[Apple Jam]] in Update 0.5.


They are used as ingredients in several food [[products]].

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Harvesting apples'''===
[[File:Apple Tree.png|150px|left|link=Apple Tree|Apple tree]]
The first harvest gives two apples, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

After the first time the tree wilts, tapping on it will show a pop-out menu consisting of two options, a [[saw]] , and a sign with an exclamition mark. If you place the sign, another player can tap on it, and revive the tree for one more harvest. After that, the tree wilts, and the only way to get rid of it is by using a saw.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling apples'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Apples can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 396 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 fruit.
* Buying an apple tree costs 160 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 apples are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 514 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 354 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.

{{Clr}}

'''Bacon''' is a type of [[Animal Goods|animal good]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 10.

It is used to make many recipes as well as feed [[:Category:Dogs|dogs]] and [[:Category:Puppies|puppies]]. It is one of the most used products in the game.

Like all [[products]], it is stored in the [[barn]].

{{Clr}}----
==='''Collecting bacon'''===
[[File:Pig Steaming.png|150px|left|Steaming a pig]]
Bacon is collected from [[pig]]s which have been fed [[Pig Feed|pig feed]]. Once fed, pigs need 4 hours to get fatter. Players can then put them in a steaming machine to get bacon.

Collecting bacon gives players 5 {{Infoicon|xp}} points.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Selling bacon'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Bacon can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 504 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 units.
* A [[pig]] costs between 500 and 2,300 {{Infoicon|coin}} and a [[Pig Pen|pig pen]] 150 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Using bacon'''===
Bacon is used to make the following [[products]]:

{{Clr}}----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* 3 units of [[Pig Feed|pig feed]] take 20 minutes to make. You can easily collect all your bacon and replenish your feed stock by the time the pigs are fat again.
* Bacon can occasionally be found in the [[Daily Dirt]] but sells very quickly. 
* Before you buy dogs take into consideration the fact that you'll have to feed them bacon or [[Lamb Chop|lamb chops]]. If you have reached [[experience]] level 25, it is more convenient to feed them lamb chops. Below experience level 25, if you don't have enough pigs or don't make enough pig feed, this might be a problem.

{{Infobox

 |price = 1 to 104

 |xp = 20
 |base = 29
 |dia = 17
 |source = {{Infoicon|bananat|bigger|link=Banana Tree}}
}}
'''Bananas''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 88. They grow on [[Banana Tree|banana trees]] and can be harvested four times. They were the last crop unlocked in the game until [[Plum|Plums]] were introduced.

They were introduced on December 12th, 2016, along with [[Grapes]].

They are used as ingredients in [[Banana Bread|banana bread]], [[Banana Pancakes|banana pancakes]], [[Banana Split|banana splits]], [[Black Sesame Smoothie|black sesame smoothies]], [[Chocolate Waffles|chocolate waffles]], [[Iced Banana Latte|iced banana lattes]], [[Tropical Smoothie|tropical smoothies]] and [[Cocoa Smoothie|cocoa smoothies]].

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

{{Clr}}----
==='''Harvesting bananas'''===
[[File:Banana Tree.png|150px|left|Banana tree]]
The first harvest gives two bananas, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

Tapping on the tree places a sign on it letting other players know the tree needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the tree dies. A [[saw]] is then required to cut it.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Selling bananas'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside shop]]
* Bananas can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 1,044 {{Infoicon|coin}} for ten fruit.
* Buying a banana tree costs 800 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 bananas are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1,357 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 557 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Using bananas'''===
Bananas are used to make the following [[products]]:

{{Ingredient usage|Banana
|Iced Banana Latte|1|88
|Banana Bread|3|91
|Black Sesame Smoothie|1|93
|Banana Pancakes|1|94
|Banana Split|1|96
|Cocoa Smoothie|2|100
|Tropical Smoothie|1|104
|Chocolate Waffles|1|117
}}
----
=== '''Boat orders''' ===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|Riverboat]]
[[Boat]] orders ask for 4 to 6 bananas per crate, up to a total of 18 per boat.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Each tree gives a maximum of 13 bananas in about 4 days and a half minimum.
* Bananas are so rare that selling them at maximum price is recommended.
* Recipes ask for 1 to 3 bananas so you need to have several extra trees to cover your needs. Extras can also be useful if you have boats with banana crates as you won't have time to grow up some.
----

'''Blackberries''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 26. They grow on [[Blackberry Bush|blackberry bushes]] and can be harvested four times.

They are used as ingredients in several [[products]].

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Harvesting blackberries'''===
[[File:Blackberry Bush.png|150px|left|link=Blackberry Bush|Blackberry bush]]
The first harvest gives two blackberries, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the bush wilts.

Tapping on the bush places a sign on it letting other players know the bush needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the bush dies. An [[axe]] is then required to cut it.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling blackberries'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Blackberries can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 828 {{Infoicon|coin}} for ten berries.
* Buying a blackberry bush costs 530 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 blackberries are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1,076 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 546 {{Infoicon|coin}} per bush.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Using blackberries'''===
Blackberries are used to make the following [[products]]:
{{Item Usage|Blackberry
|Blackberry Muffin|2|26
|Berry Juice|1|31
|Blackberry Jam|3|37
|Berry Smoothie|3|64
|Flower Shawl|1|71
|Fruit Salad|2|82
|Banana Pancakes|2|94
|Berry Waffles|2|114
|Breakfast Bowl|2|119}}

----
==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|link=Boat|Riverboat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for 4 to 6 blackberries per crate, up to a total of 24 per boat.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Each bush gives a maximum of 13 blackberries in 5 days minimum. 
* Blackberries are the least profitable bush crop on an hourly basis, earning only 4.1 coins per hour. However, on a per-axe basis, they are more profitable than raspberries, coffee, or blueberries, making them useful for coin farming if you have enough axes and no space constraints.
* Although blackberries can occasionally be found in the [[Daily Dirt]] you shouldn't expect to get them there. They are rare enough that selling them at maximum price is recommended.
* Recipes ask for 1 to 3 blackberries so you need to have several extra bushes to cover your needs. Extras can also be useful if you have [[boat]]s with blackberry crates. However, make sure you have enough [[axe]]s when you harvest some if you don't want to have dead bushes on your farm.
* Tight ranks of bushes attract [[Animals|foxes]]. If it's an issue space them out a bit.
* Saving revivable bushes and trees is an easy way to achieve help tasks during [[Derby|derbies]]. [[Neighborhood|Neighbors]] and [[friends]] can help by waiting until you have started your task to flag their dead plants.
----

'''Cacao beans''' (also called '''cocoa beans''') are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 36. They grow on [[Cacao Tree|cacao trees]] and can be harvested four times.

They are used as ingredients in several recipes, and [[chocolate]] in particular which takes the longest time to make in the game.

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Harvesting cacao'''===
[[File:Cacao Tree.png|150px|left|link=Cacao Tree|Cacao tree]]
The first harvest gives two cacao beans, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

Tapping on the tree places a sign on it letting other players know the tree needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the tree dies. A [[saw]] is then required to cut it.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling cacao'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Cacao can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 864 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 fruit.
* Buying a cacao tree costs 550 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 cacao are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1,123 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 573 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.

==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Each tree gives a maximum of 13 cacao beans in less than 6 days
* They are rare enough that selling them at a lower price is not recommended.

* Cacao beans are very hard to find in the [[Daily Dirt]].
* Recipes ask for one to three beans so you need to have several extra trees to cover your needs. Extras can also be useful if you have boats with cacao crates.

'''Carrots''' are field [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 9.

They are used to make many recipes, notably feed for [[pig]]s and [[goat]]s, as well as to feed [[:Category:Bunnies|bunnies]], [[:Category:Donkeys|donkeys]] and [[:Category:Horses|horses]].

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 110 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Growing carrots'''===
Carrots are grown in [[Farm|fields]] by planting another carrot (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 2 {{Infoicon|xp}} points, and takes 10 minutes to mature.

* Each unit of carrot gives players 3 coins and 3 experience points in boat orders.

==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Carrots are uncommon enough that selling them at a lower price is not necessary.
* Carrots can very often be found in the [[Daily Dirt]], but sell pretty quickly.
* Recipes only ask for one to five carrots. However, if you have many animals and pets, you want to make sure you always have enough of them in your silo.

* Carrots can help sustain a normal vision.

'''Cherries''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 22. They grow on [[Cherry Tree|cherry trees]] and can be harvested four times.

They are used as ingredients in several food [[products]].

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Harvesting cherries'''===
[[File:Cherry Tree.png|150px|left|link=Cherry Tree|Cherry tree]]
The first harvest gives two cherries, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

Tapping on the tree places a sign on it letting other players know the tree needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the tree dies. A [[saw]] is then required to cut it.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling cherries'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Cherries can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 684 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 fruit.
* Buying a cherry tree costs 410 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 cherries are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 889 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 479 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Using cherries'''===
Cherries are used to make the following [[products]]:
{{Item Usage|Cherry
|Red Berry Cake|2|23
|Cherry Juice|2|30
|Cherry Jam|3|38
|Lollipop|1|57
|Pineapple Cake|2|65
|Yogurt Smoothie|1|70
|Fruit Cake|2|89
|Banana Split|3|96
}}

----
==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|link=Boat|Riverboat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for 4 to 8 cherries per crate, up to a total of 28 per boat.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Each tree gives a maximum of 13 cherries in about 14 days minimum.
* They are rare enough that selling them at a lower price is not recommended.
* Cherries are very hard to find in the [[Daily Dirt]] so selling them at maximum price is recommended.
* Recipes ask for one to three cherries so you need to have several extra trees to cover your needs. Extras can also be useful if you have boats with cherry crates.
----

'''Coconuts''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 101. They grow on [[Coconut Tree|coconut trees]] and can be harvested four times.

They were introduced on 27th September 2022. 

They are used as ingredients for [[macaroon]]s, [[Coconut Ice Cream|coconut ice cream]], [[Tropical Smoothie|tropical smoothies]] and [[Chickpea Stew|chickpea stew]]. 

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Harvesting coconuts'''===
[[File:Coconut Tree.png|150px|left|link=Coconut Tree|Coconut tree]]
The first harvest gives two coconuts, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

Tapping on the tree places a sign on it letting other players know the tree needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the tree dies. A [[saw]] is then required to cut it.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling coconuts'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside shop]]
* Coconuts can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 1,080 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 coconuts.
* Buying a coconut tree costs 810 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 coconuts are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1,404 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 594 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.

{{Clr}}
----
=== '''Using coconuts''' ===
Coconuts are used to make the following [[products]]:

{{Clr}}

*Each tree gives a maximum of 13 coconuts in 6 days minimum, which gives players 4 coins per hour profit.

'''Corn''' is a field [[crops|crop]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 2.

It is the second crop unlocked in the game and is used to make several food [[products]], notably [[Popcorn Pot|popcorn]] and feed for [[chicken]]s and [[cow]]s.

Due to its short production time, corn is often used to farm [[experience]] points or get [[:Category:Supplies|supplies]], much like [[wheat]].

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 110 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Growing corn'''===
Corn is grown in [[Farm|fields]] by planting another corn plant (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 1 {{Infoicon|xp}} point, and takes 5 minutes to mature.

Corn Stage 1.png

Corn Stage 4.png
Corn Stage 5.png
</gallery>

}}

==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|thumb|150px|left|link=Boat|Boat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for 50 to 102 corn per crate, up to a total of 408 per boat.
* Each unit of corn gives players 2 coins and 2 experience points in boat orders.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
[[File:Corn Daily Dirt.png|thumb|175px|right|Corn is commonly found in [[Daily Dirt]]]]
* Corn is so common that selling it at high prices may result in fewer or slower sales.
* Corn can always be found in the [[Daily Dirt]].
* Recipes ask for one to four units of corn. If you make lots of popcorn or have many farm animals, make sure you always have enough of it.
* [[Corn Bread|Corn bread]] is used to make [[taco]]s, [[Fish Taco|fish tacos]], and [[Onion Melt|onion melts]].
* Wheating is always preferred over CORNING as corn takes 5 min and won't get sold quickly if you are selling at a high price, however, wheat gets sold more often, even at a high price.
*[[Visitors]] in your farm pay only 28 per 10 corn. Even during events where they pay double, this will be lower than the maximum price in the [[Roadside Shop]].
{{Clr}}
----

==='''Did you know'''===
*Corn is indirectly required to make the most amount of products: 109, nearly half.
**This is because it's required to make both [[Chicken Feed|Chicken]], and [[Cow Feed]], which means it's required to get [[Egg]]s, and [[Milk]], which are key ingredients in most recipes.

{{Clr}}
----

'''Duck feathers''' are [[Animal Goods|animal goods]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 50.

They are used to make [[pillow]]s, [[blanket]]s, [[Top Hat|top hats]] and [[Sun Hat|sun hats]].

Like all goods, they are stored in the [[barn]].
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Trapping ducks'''===
[[File:Duck_Trapped.png|150px|left|A trapped duck]]
Ducks can only be caught in [[Duck Trap|duck traps]]. Only 1 duck is caught per trap. It takes 2 hours to catch a duck once the trap has been placed into the water. Players can speed this up by spending 5 [[diamond]]s.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Collecting duck feathers'''===
[[File:Duck Salon Stage6.png|150px|left|The Duck Salon]]
Duck feathers are collected from [[duck]]s which have been given hair cuts in the [[Duck Salon]]. Once caught, each duck needs to stay in the salon for 3 hours to yield a feather. Players can speed this up by spending 6 [[diamond]]s.

Collecting a feather gives players 17 {{Infoicon|xp}} points.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling duck feathers'''===
[[File:Duck Feather RSS.png|150px|thumb|left|Selling at Roadside Shop]]
* Duck feathers can be bought or sold at [[Roadside Shop]] for a maximum price of 1,404 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 feathers.
* Making [[Duck Trap|duck traps]] requires no material and does not cost anything.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Using duck feathers'''===
Duck feathers are used to make the following [[products]]:
{{Item Usage|Duck Feather
|Pillow|3|51
|Blanket|5|59
|Top Hat|1|72
|Sun Hat|2|74
}}

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|link=Boat|Riverboat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for 3 to 6 duck feathers per crate, up to a total of 24 per boat.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Catching a duck requires making a [[Duck Trap|duck trap]] (60 min) then letting it sit in the water for 2 hours then letting the duck sit in duck salon for 3 hours.
* Recipes ask between 1 and 5 feathers.
* Duck feathers are so rare that selling them at maximum price is recommended. Alternatively, you can use them to make other products to get more coins. Blanket is a good example, which has the highest maximum price among all products.

{{Clr}}

'''Grapes''' are field [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 84.

They are used to make [[Banana Bread|banana bread]], [[Dried Fruit|dried fruits]], [[Fruit Cake|fruit cakes]], [[Goat Cheese Toast|goat cheese toasts]], [[Grape Jam|grape jam]], [[Grape Juice|grape juice]] and [[Plum Smoothie|plum smoothies]].

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 480 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

Grapes are grown in [[Farm|fields]] by planting another grape (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 6 [[experience]] points, and takes 3 hours to mature.

'''Guava''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 104. They grow on [[Guava Tree|guava trees]] and can be harvested four times, with each harvest giving varying numbers of guavas. They were introduced on 28th November 2022. 

They are used as ingredients in several food [[products]].

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Harvesting guavas'''===
[[File:Guava Tree.png|150px|left|link=Guava Tree|Guava tree]]
The first harvest gives two guavas, the second one three, the third and the fourth harvests give four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

After the first time the tree wilts, tapping on it will show a pop-out menu consisting of two options, a [[saw]] , and a sign with an exclamation mark. If you place the sign, another player can tap on it, and revive the tree for one more harvest. After that, the tree wilts, and the only way to get rid of it is by using a saw.

{{Clr}}
----

'''Honeycomb''' is a type of [[Animal Goods|animal good]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 39.

It is used to make [[honey]], [[beeswax]] and [[Honey Soap|honey soap]].

Like all goods, it is stored in the [[barn]].

{{Clr}}----
==='''Collecting honeycomb'''===
[[File:Honey Bee.png|150px|left|Honey bee]]
[[File:Beehive Tree Stage 4.png|150px|left|Beehive tree]]
Honeycomb is collected from beehives in the [[Beehive Tree |beehive tree]].

To make one piece of honeycomb, [[Honey Bee|honey bees]] need to gather 100 drops of nectar from [[Nectar Bush|nectar bushes]] and bring them to the tree. This takes approximately 33 minutes if bushes are close enough to the tree. Honeycomb can then be collected immediately.

Collecting one piece of honeycomb gives players 8 {{Infoicon|xp}} points.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Selling honeycomb'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Honeycomb can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 684 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 units.
* A [[Honey Bee|honey bee]] costs between 1,500 and 3,000 {{Infoicon|coin}} and a [[Nectar Bush|nectar bush]] costs 120 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* The [[Beehive Tree |beehive tree]] costs 4,000 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Using honeycomb'''===
Honeycomb is used to make the following [[products]]:

{{Item Usage|Honeycomb
|Honey|2|39
|Beeswax|3|48
|Honey Soap|1|84
|Chamomile Tea|1|100
}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Recipes ask between 2 and 3 pieces of honeycomb.
* Honeycomb is very rare to be bought. You need to prepare some of it to make other recipes.
* Honeycomb gives low revenue that selling it is not recommended. Instead, you can use honeycomb to make honey or beeswax then sell it to get greater revenue.
* Honeycomb is never requested in [[boat]] orders.
----
==='''Did you know?'''===
[[File:Skep.png|150px|left|Skep]]
* The woven straw basket used to collect honeycomb in the game is called a '''skep'''.

'''Lemons''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 66. They grow on [[Lemon Tree|lemon trees]] and can be harvested four times.

They are mostly used as ingredients in drinks and sauces but also as a scent for candles.

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Harvesting lemons'''===
[[File:Lemon Tree.png|150px|left|Lemon tree]]
The first harvest gives two lemons, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

After the first time the tree wilts, tapping on it will show a pop-out menu consisting of two options, a [[saw]], and a sign with an exclamition mark. If you place the sign, another player can tap on it, and revive the tree for one more harvest. After that, the tree wilts, and the only way to get rid of it is by using a saw.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling lemons'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside shop]]
* Lemons can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 936 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 fruit.
* Buying a lemon tree costs 670 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 lemons are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1,216 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 546 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.
{{Clr}}
----

* Each tree gives a maximum of 13 lemons in 5 days. 
* They are rare enough that selling them at a lower price is not recommended.
* Lemons are very hard to find in the [[Daily Dirt]].
* Recipes only ask for one or two lemons so you do not need to have many lemon trees. However, as lemons take a very long time to grow it is sill best to have more trees than strictly necessary. Extras can also be useful if you have [[boat]]s with lemon crates.

==='''Trapping lobsters'''===
[[File:Lobster_Trap_Full.png|150px|left|A trapped lobster]]
Lobsters can only be caught in [[Lobster Trap|lobster traps]]. Only 1 lobster is caught per trap. It takes 6 hours to catch a lobster after the trap has been placed into the water. Players can speed this up by spending 8 [[diamond]]s.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Collecting lobster tails'''===
[[File:Lobster Pool Stage 6.png|150px|left|The Lobster Pool]]
Lobster tails are collected from [[lobster]]s which have been put in the [[Lobster Pool]]. Once caught, each lobster needs to stay in the pool for 6 hours to yield a tail. Players can speed this up by spending 8 [[diamond]]s.

Collecting a tail gives players 24 {{Infoicon|xp}} points.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling lobster tails'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Lobster tails can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 2,016 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 tails.
* Making [[Lobster Trap|lobster traps]] does not require any material and does not cost anything.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Using lobster tails'''===
Lobster tails are used to make the following [[products]]:

|Lobster Sushi|1|59

}}

----
==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|link=Boat|Riverboat]]

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Catching a lobster requires making a [[Lobster Trap|lobster trap]] (2 h) then letting it sit in the water for 6 hours.

'''Mangoes''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 97. They grow on [[Mango Tree|mango trees]] and can be harvested four times.

They were introduced on 30th May 2022.

They are used as ingredients for [[Mango Juice|mango juice]], [[Tropical Fondue|tropical fondue]], and [[Tropical Yogurt|tropical yogurt]]. 

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

{{Clr}}----
==='''Harvesting mangoes'''===
[[File:Mango Tree.png|150px|left|link=Mango Tree|Mango tree]]
The first harvest gives two mangoes, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

Tapping on the tree places a sign on it letting other players know the tree needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the tree dies. A [[saw]] is then required to cut it.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Selling mangoes'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside shop]]
* Mangoes can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 1008 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 mangoes.
* Buying a mango tree costs 770 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 mangoes are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1,310 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 540 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.

'''Olives''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 57. They grow on [[Olive Tree|olives trees]] and can be harvested four times.

They are used as ingredients in three [[products]] only, but one of them is [[Olive Oil|olive oil]], which is, in turn, used to make several other recipes.

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

{{Clr}}----
==='''Harvesting olives'''===
[[File:Olive Tree.png|150px|left|Olive tree]]
The first harvest gives two olives, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

Tapping on the tree places a sign on it letting other players know the tree needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the tree dies. A [[saw]] is then required to cut it.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Selling olives'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside shop]]
* Olives can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 828 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 fruit.
* Buying an olive tree costs 620 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 olives are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1,076 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 456 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.

{{Clr}}----
=== '''Using olives''' ===
Olives are used to make the following [[products]]:
{{Item Usage|Olive
|Feta Salad|2|58
|Olive Oil|3|60
|Olive Dip|3|66
}}

----
=== '''Boat orders''' ===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|Riverboat]]
[[Boat]] orders ask for 4 to 6 olives per crate, up to a total of 24 per boat.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* '''You must always make sure you have enough olives, because they are needed for the [[Olive Oil|olive oil]] that is made in the [[Sauce Maker|sauce maker]]. Olive oil is needed for many other [[products]]!!!!!!'''
*Each tree gives a maximum of 13 olives in 4 days.
* They are rare enough that selling them at a lower price is not recommended.
* Olives are very hard to find in the [[Daily Dirt]].
* Recipes ask for two or three olives so you need to have several extra trees to cover your needs. Extras can also be useful if you have boats with olive crates.
----

'''Oranges''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 71. They grow on [[Orange Tree|orange tree]]s and can be harvested four times.

They are used to make some drinks and a few dishes.

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].
{{Clr}}
----
=== '''Harvesting oranges''' ===
[[File:Orange Tree.png|150px|left]]
The first harvest gives two oranges, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

Tapping on the tree places a sign on it letting other players know the tree needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the tree dies. A [https://hayday.wikia.com/wiki/Saw saw] is then required to cut it.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling oranges'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside Shop]]
* Oranges can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 972 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 fruit.
* Buying a orange tree costs 720 {{Infoicon|coin}}. 
* Given all 13 oranges are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1263 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 543 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.
{{Clr}}
----
=== '''Using oranges''' ===
Oranges are used to make the following [[products]]:

}}

----
=== '''Boat orders''' ===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|Riverboat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for 4 to 6 oranges per crate, up to a total of 18 per boat.
{{Clr}}
----
=== '''Strategy tips''' ===
* Each tree gives a maximum of 13 oranges in about 5 days minimum.
* They are rare enough that selling them at a lower price is not recommended.

'''Peaches''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 76. They grow on [[Peach Tree|peach tree]]s and can be harvested four times.

They are used to make a few recipes.

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].
{{Clr}}
----
=== '''Harvesting peaches''' ===
[[File:Peach Tree.png|left|150px|Peach Tree]]
The first harvest gives two peaches, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the bush wilts.

Tapping on the bush places a sign on it letting other players know the bush needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the bush dies. An [[axe]] is then required to cut it.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling peaches'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside Shop]]
* Peaches can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 1,008 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 fruit.
* Buying a peach tree costs 750 {{Infoicon|coin}}. 
* Given all 13 peaches are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1310 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 560 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.
{{Clr}}
----
=== '''Using peaches''' ===
Peaches are used to make the following [[products]]:
{{Item Usage|Peach
|Peach Tart|3|76
|Peach Jam|3|79
|Peach Ice Cream|2|83
|Summer Salad|1|84
|Mixed Smoothie|2|88
|Iced Tea|1|92
|Sweet Porridge|1|120
}}

----
=== '''Boat orders''' ===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|Riverboat]]
[[Boat]] orders ask for 4 to 6 peaches per crate, up to a total of 20 per boat.
{{Clr}}
----
=== '''Strategy tips''' ===
* Each tree gives a maximum of 13 peaches in about 5 days minimum.
* They are rare enough that selling them at a lower price is not recommended.
----

=== '''Strategy tips''' ===
*Pineapples can sometimes be found in the [[Daily Dirt]].
*It is not recommended to sell them at a lower price since they are not a common item in the Daily Dirt.
*Recipes ask for 3 pineapples. You may want to make sure you always have enough of them in your [[silo]]. However, since they grow quickly it is not recommended to store too many pineapples because it can clog up room in your silo. When storing pineapples, consider your current level and how many pineapple related dishes you can make. Another consideration is do you do truck, boat, or townie orders because each order type will ask for a different number of the pineapple related dishes. Ensure that you do not use your last pineapple because there is no guarantee you will be able to find some in the Daily Dirt when you need them.
----

'''Plums''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 94. They grow on [[Plum Tree|plum trees]] and can be harvested four times.

They were introduced on 25th June 2018.

They are used as ingredients for [[Plum Jam|plum jam]], [[Plum Smoothie|plum smoothies]], and [[Rice Ball|rice balls]]. 

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

{{Clr}}----
==='''Harvesting plums'''===
[[File:Plum Tree.png|150px|left|link=Plum Tree|Plum tree]]
The first harvest gives two plums, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

Tapping on the tree places a sign on it letting other players know the tree needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the tree dies. A [[saw]] is then required to cut it.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Selling plums'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside shop]]
* Plums can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 828 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 plums.
* Buying a plum tree costs 600 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 plums are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 1,076 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 476 {{Infoicon|coin}} per tree.

{{Clr}}----
=== '''Using plums''' ===
Plums are used to make the following [[products]]:
{{Item Usage|Plum
|Plum Jam|3|94
|Plum Smoothie|3|102
|Rice Ball|1|110
}}

{{Clr}}----
=== '''Boat orders''' ===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|Riverboat]]
[[Boat]] orders ask for 4 to 6 plums per crate, up to a total of 20 per boat.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
*Each tree gives a maximum of 13 plums in 4 days minimum, which gives players 4.76 coins per hour.
*Its selling price is same as [[Blackberry]] but selling plum is more profitable because plum requires less time to harvest.

'''Pomegranate''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 107. They grow on [[Pomegranate Tree|pomegranate trees]] and can be harvested four times, with each harvest giving varying numbers of pomegranates. They were introduced in the Spring 2023 update.

==='''Harvesting pomegranates'''===
[[File:Pomegranate Tree.png|150px|left|link=Pomegranate Tree|Pomegranate tree]]
The first harvest gives two pomegranates, the second one three, the third and the fourth harvests give four. After the third harvest the tree wilts.

After the first time the tree wilts, tapping on it will show a pop-out menu consisting of two options, a [[saw]] , and a sign with an exclamation mark. If you place the sign, another player can tap on it, and revive the tree for one more harvest. After that, the tree wilts, and the only way to get rid of it is by using a saw.

'''Raspberries''' are fruit [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 19. They grow on [[Raspberry Bush|raspberry bushes]] and can be harvested four times.

They are used as ingredients in several food [[products]] but also as a dyeing agent for clothes and a scent for candles.

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Harvesting raspberries'''===
[[File:Raspberry Bush.png|150px|left|link=Raspberry Bush|Raspberry bush]]
The first harvest gives two raspberries, the second one three, and the other two four. After the third harvest the bush wilts.

Tapping on the bush places a sign on it letting other players know the bush needs to be revived. Once it is, a last harvest can be done before the bush dies. An [[axe]] is then required to cut it.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling raspberries'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Raspberries can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 468 {{Infoicon|coin}} for ten fruit.
* Buying a raspberry bush costs 220 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* Given all 13 raspberries are collected during the four harvests, the batch can be sold for 608 {{Infoicon|coin}}, thus giving a profit of 388 {{Infoicon|coin}} per bush.
{{Clr}}
----

==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Each bush gives a maximum of 13 raspberries in 72 hours minimum.
* Although raspberries can occasionally be found in the [[Daily Dirt]] you shouldn't expect to get them there. They are rare enough that selling them at maximum price is recommended.
* Recipes ask for 1 to 3 raspberries so you need to have several extra bushes to cover your needs. Extras can also be useful if you have [[boat]]s with raspberry crates. However, make sure you have enough [[axe]]s when you harvest some if you don't want to have dead bushes on your farm.
* Tight ranks of bushes attract [[Animals|foxes]]. If it's an issue space them out a bit.
* Saving revivable bushes and trees is an easy way to achieve help tasks during [[Derby|derbies]]. [[Neighborhood|Neighbors]] and [[friends]] can help by waiting until you have started your task to flag their dead plants.

'''Strawberries''' are field [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 34. They are the field crop which takes the longest time to grow.

They are used as ingredients in several food [[products]] but also as a dyeing agent for clothes and a scent for candles.

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 750 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Growing strawberries'''===
Strawberries are grown in [[Farm|fields]] by planting another strawberry (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 10 {{Infoicon|xp}} points, and takes 8 hours to mature.
<gallery>

Strawberry Stage 2.png

Strawberry Stage 5.png
</gallery>

{{Clr}}----

|Chocolate Waffles|3|117
}}
----
==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|thumb|150px|left|link=Boat|Boat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for 3 to 10 strawberries per crate, up to a total of 36 per boat.
* Each unit of strawberry gives players 19 coins and 14 experience points in boat orders.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Strawberries are rare enough that selling them at a lower price is not necessary.
* Strawberries can occasionally be found in the [[Daily Dirt]].
* Recipes ask for two to three strawberries so they are not a crop you need to keep very large quantities of.
* Strawberries are the least profitable of all field crops due to their 8 hour harvest time, earning a mere 6.3 coins per hour.
* Strawberries are the longest time taking crops (8 hours) in the game. Planting them overnight while sleeping is highly recommended.
----

'''Tea leaves''' are field [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 80.

They are exclusively used to make tea: [[Green Tea|green tea]], [[Milk Tea|milk tea]], [[Honey Tea|honey tea]], [[Lemon Tea|lemon tea]], [[Orange Tea|orange tea]], [[Iced Tea|iced tea]], [[Mint Tea|mint tea]], and [[Apple Ginger Tea|apple ginger tea]].

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 650 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Growing tea leaves'''===
Tea leaves are grown in [[Farm|fields]] by planting another tea leaf (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 9 [[experience]] points, and takes 6 hours and 30 minutes to mature.
<gallery>
Tea Leaf Stage 1.png
Tea Leaf Stage 2.png
Tea Leaf Stage 3.png
Tea Leaf Stage 4.png
Tea Leaf Stage 5.png
</gallery>
----
=== '''Selling tea leaves''' ===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside Shop]]
* Tea leaves can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 432 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 units.

{{Clr}}----
=== '''Using tea leaves''' ===
Tea leaves are used to make the following [[products]]:

{{Item Usage|Tea Leaf
|Green Tea|5|80
|Milk Tea|3|81
|Honey Tea|3|83
|Lemon Tea|3|86
|Apple Ginger Tea|1|88
|Orange Tea|3|89
|Iced Tea|3|92
|Mint Tea|3|97
|Pomegranate Tea|4|107}}
----
=== '''Boat orders''' ===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|Riverboat]]
[[Boat]] orders ask for 7 to 11 tea leaves per crate, up to a total of 33 per boat.

{{Clr}}----
=== '''Strategy tips''' ===
* As recipes ask for one to five tea leaves. You need to keep large quantities of them in your [[silo]], especially as they take a very long time to grow whereas tea is quick to brew in comparison.
* Tea Leaves are one of the rarer crops in the Daily Dirt. You can hardly find these in the newspaper and they sell very quickly. Always remember to plant them overnight, just like tomatoes, asparagus, strawberries...
----

==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|thumb|150px|left|link=Boat|Boat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for:
** 19 to 29 wheat per crate, up to a total of 58 per boat (for two crates).
** 14 to 106 wheat per crate, up to a total of 318 per boat (for three crates).
** 13 to 79 wheat per crate, up to a total of 316 per boat (for four crates).
* Each unit of wheat gives players 2 coins and 1 experience point in boat orders.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Wheat can be sold to [[visitors]] at 28 coins for each 10 units.
* Harvesting wheat gains you the most {{Infoicon|xp}} points and [[:Category:Supplies|supplies]] per minute. Continuously harvesting wheat is often called "wheating".
** However, don't go all out on wheat as you will not be able to continue. Have a wide variety of plants growing at the same time.
** If you have the [[sanctuary]] unlocked, wheating can be a very effective way to produce enough wheat for [[Wheat Bundle|wheat bundles]], although you will want to make sure you have the space beforehand.
* Wheat sells quickly in the [[Roadside Shop|roadside shop]], even at the max price of 36, since it is one of the most commonly used crops. However, when wheating, the silo must be emptied rapidly, so the usual selling speed may be too slow.
** Many players increase selling speed when wheating by pricing their wheat stacks as low as possible: 1 coin. 
** At a price that low, however, the 5-minute cooldown for a free advertisement in the [[Daily Dirt]] will quickly outpace the 2-minute harvest time. It is better to advertise wheat for 35 coins and to stock the rest of your shop with wheat priced for 10-34 coins. The advertised wheat will be the last to go, so you can keep re-stocking your shop with cheaper alternatives, maximizing the run-time of the ad and drawing the most possible people to your shop.
* Wheat is the basic crop, used in making the most amount of products, mainly in the [[Bakery]], [[Pie Oven]], and [[Cake Oven]]. It is recommended to always have a good amount in your silo. However, wheat can be found in the Daily Dirt without too much effort.
* As Wheat is used to make a lot of basic products, such as [[Chicken Feed]], or [[Bread]], it's required to make about 90 products, but both [[Soybean]], and [[Corn]] are used for more.
* The total production time of a max-size wheat crate is 3 hours and 22 minutes, around 17% of a boat's stay time. Therefore it should have low priority in boat management, usually being handled in the background while other production are in progress.

Wheat Bundle.title: Wheat Bundle
Wheat Bundle.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}} [[File:Wheat Bundle.png|200px|left|Wheat bundle]] {{Infobox |title = [[Products|Product]] |rlevel = 3, requires
at least one [[sanctuary]] animal |price = 1 to 50 |time = 1 h 30 min |source = {{Infoicon|FeedM|bigger|link=Feed Mill}} |xp = 10 |base = 14 |time3 = 1 h 16 min |dia = 6 }} '''Wheat bundles''' are [[products]] unlocked when players reached [[reputation]] level 3, unlocked [[Sanctuary]] and have at least one sanctuary animal. They are used to feed almost all sanctuary animals. Like all [[products]], they are stored in the [[barn]]. {{Clr}} ---- ==='''Making wheat bundles'''=== [[File:Feed Mill.png|150px|left|Feed Mill]] Wheat bundles are made in the [[Feed Mill]]. Like other feeds, wheat bundles are made in quantities of three. To make a three unit bundle of wheat players need the following ingredient, in the specified quantity: {| border="0" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="1" style="text-align: center; margin: .5em 0;" |- |[[File:Wheat.png|75px|Wheat|link=Wheat]] |- |'''x75''' |} It takes 1 hour 30 minutes to make one bundle, or 1 hour 16 minutes in a fully [[Masteries|mastered]] Feed mill. 1 bundle equals 3 units and awards players 10 {{Infoicon|xp}} points. {{Clr}} ---- ==='''Selling wheat bundles'''=== [[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside Shop]] * Wheat bundles can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 504 {{Infoicon|Coin}} for 10 bundles. * Buying the ingredients required to make 3 wheat bundles costs 225 {{Infoicon|Coin}} {{Clr}} ---- ==='''Strategy tips'''=== * While [[Rose]] can make other types of feed for you at the feed mill if you hire her (using [[diamond]]s or the ''Free Rose'' [[booster]]), Rose does not make nor store wheat bundles. * [[Truck]] orders, [[boat]]s and [[Town Visitors|town visitors]] never ask for any type of feed. * This product requires the most amount of [[crops]] of any single product in the game. * Making wheat bundles can also get rid of the high quantity of wheat in the silo when wheating. * Making wheat bundles can easily master [[Feed Mill]] because it requires the most amount of time to produce. * Wheat Bundle is quite rare to be found in [[Daily Dirt]] or in someone's [[Roadside Shop]]. Selling it at maximum price is recommended. As it's difficult to purchase, you should have a few in your barn to feed sanctuary animals. {{Clr}} ---- ==='''Did you know?'''=== * Among the products that require wheat to produce, Wheat Bundle is the only product with "Wheat" in it's name. * This is the product with the most unlocking requirements. If it is available for sale at [[Roadside Shop]] but the buyer hasn't unlocked it the notice "Requires sanctuary animals" will be written, the final step required to unlock this product. * Almost all sanctuary animals, including hippos, giraffes, elephants, gorillas, zebras, reindeer and meerkats need Wheat Bundle for food. The only exceptions are the arctic foxes, walruses and cheetahs, which need [[Meat Bucket|meat buckets]]. * The ingredients required to make the 3 wheat bundles costs 225 {{Infoicon|Coin}}, but the price of those 3 wheat bundles are only 150 {{Infoicon|Coin}}, making it one of the few products in the game where the ingredients cost more than the product, the other products that has this feature are [[Tower Doner Supreme]], [[Jelly Beans]] and [[Birthday Bouquet]]. {{Clr}} ---- {{Navigation}} {{Languages |de = Weizenbündel |es = Haz de trigo |fr = Gerbe de Blé |it = Mazzo di grano |nl = Tarwebundel |no = Hvetepakke |vi = Bó lúa mỳ |zh = Wheat Bundle }} [[pt-br:Punhado de trigo]] [[ru:Охапка пшеницы]] [[Category:Feed Mill Products]] [[Category:Wheat Products]]

'''Asparagus''' is field [[crops]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 49. It was added in Summer 2023 Update.

It's used to make [[Asparagus Quiche|asparagus quiche]], [[Asparagus Soup|asparagus soup]], [[Grilled Asparagus|grilled asparagus]], [[Spring Omelet|spring omelet]] and [[Breakfast Waffles|breakfast waffles]].

* Asparagus, like tomatoes, are hard to find in the [[Daily Dirt]] and sells well at maximum price.
** However, be mindful that asparagus will sell slightly slower than tomatoes due to there being less recipes that use it compared to tomatoes.
* With the exception of grilled asparagus, most recipes only require two to three asparagus, while you won't need to keep that much on hand, be very careful about selling or using all of your asparagus without planting a few since you will have a very difficult time finding it in the [[Daily Dirt]].

Diamond.title: Diamond
Diamond.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}}
[[File:Diamond.png|left|200px]]
'''Diamonds''' are the premium [[Currencies|currency]] of the game. They are not required to play and progress in the game but let players buy special [[decorations]] and [[customization]] options, or progress faster.

Diamonds are also used to make three special products: [[Mystery Net|mystery nets]], [[Diamond Ring|diamond rings]] and [[Gracious Bouquet|gracious bouquets]].

{{Clr}}----

==='''Obtaining diamonds through in-game means'''===
Players are given 30 diamonds at the start of the game. There are many ways to obtain additional Diamonds for free:

*Completing [[achievements]] (477 total diamonds)
*Catching new [[Fishing|fish]] (430 total diamonds)
*Excavating them in the [[mine]] (Limit of 10 per day)
*Finding them in [[Mystery Box]]es and [[Mystery Box|Treasure Chests]]
*Finding them in [[Mystery Box|Seasonal Mystery Gifts]] in the fishing area
*Buying mystery packages in the [[Catalogue]]
*Catching them with [[Mystery Net|mystery nets]]
*Watching [[Daily Reward|Night at the Movies]] ads
*Participating in certain global [[events]]
*Receiving a gift package from [[Alfred]] after a maintenance event
*Popping [[Tom]]'s balloon
*Reaching a [[derby]] threshold
*Advancing to the next [[Experience Levels|experience level]] (beginning at level 37)
*Advancing to the next [[Reputation Levels|reputation level]]
*Buying them in [[Valley Shop]]
*Completing styles in the [[Customization/Style Book|style book]]

{{Clr}}----
==='''Obtaining diamonds using real currency'''===
Diamonds can be '''purchased''' using real money, providing players have enabled in-app purchases in their device settings.

To buy diamonds players need to tap on the + (plus) icon near the diamond counter and select an option:

Occasionally, a player may be selected for a special discount. These deals are randomly assigned and last for an hour at a time, or, if it is a holiday discount, a full day.
----
==='''Double-tap confirmation'''===
To reduce unintentional use of diamonds, players can enable double-tap confirmation in their [[settings]]. However, this does not apply to all actions such as buying decorations or getting missing items.
----
==='''Using diamonds to make special items'''===
{{Main|Mystery Net}}
{{Main|Diamond Ring}}
{{Main|Gracious Bouquet}}
Diamonds can be used to make the following [[products]]:

{{Item Usage|Diamond
|Mystery Net|5|30
|Diamond Ring|1|40
|Gracious Bouquet|1|73
}}

Diamond rings are requested in jewelry [[truck]] orders and in the [[Gift Shop]] in the [[town]].

Mystery nets are used to catch special items in the [[Fishing Lake|fishing lake]].
----
==='''Other uses'''===
Diamonds can also be used to:
* Add new machine slots
* Adding additional boxes to the [[Roadside Shop]]
* Get another spin in the [[Wheel of Fortune]]
* Get one extra task in [[Derby|derbies]]
* Speed things up (for repairs, construction, production and masteries)
* Skip waiting times between [[Boat|riverboats]] and random [[catalogue]] ads
* Get missing items
* Buy certain [[decorations]]
* Shuffle rewards in [[Derby|derbies]]
* Buy certain renovation [[Customization|options]], or get new options from [[Maggie]].
* Buy fuel from the fuel station in the [[Valley]].

See the tables below for more details.
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Diamonds should be first spent on adding machines slot and adding boxes in the Roadside Shop.  These have permanent value and will benefit you throughout the game.  Spending diamonds on any other task (making Diamond Rings, making Mystery Nets, buying Tom/Rose/Ernest/Rose/Greg, speeding up machines/buildings/repairs, buying crops/products/decorations, etc.) only provides a temporary benefit.
* There are several third party websites who offer in-game currency for Hay Day. Using sites like these are against Hay Day's [http://supercell.com/en/terms-of-service/ Terms of Service], and they reserve the right to take actions against accounts that do not follow their terms.
* See [[User blog:DarrenPaul/Buying Diamonds from Tom!!!!!!!!|DarrenPaul's guide]] on how to use Tom to mine diamonds.
* Provided a player can spare the barn space for their long-term storage, and is not in greater need of other items from him, hiring Tom and using at least the first few requests for rings is a more efficient use of diamonds than making the rings at the [[jeweler]].
----

Fish Fillet.title: Fish Fillet
Fish Fillet.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}} [[File:Fish Fillet.png|200px|left|Fish fillet]]

{{Infobox
 |title = [[Animal Goods|Animal good]]
 |level = 27
 |price = 1 to 54
 |time = Instant
 |xp = 4 to 20
 |source = {{Infoicon|fish|bigger|link=Fish}}
 |base = 15
 |dia = Varies upon location
}}
'''Fish fillets''' are [[Animal Goods|animal goods]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 27.

They are used to make various products (pizzas, tacos, soup,...).

Like all goods, they are stored in the [[barn]].

{{Clr}}----
==='''Collecting fish fillets'''===
[[File:Sockeye Salmon.png|150px|left|Fish]] Fish fillets are collected from [[fish]] that have been caught in the [[Fishing Lake|fishing lake]]. If players use [[lure]]s to catch fish fillets can be yielded in a few seconds; however, that fishing spot can't be used for a period of time, based on the spot, for 2 to 4 hours. If players use [[Fishing Net|nets]] they get 3 fillets after 20 hours.

Collecting a fillet gives players between 4 and 20 {{Infoicon|xp}} points, depending on the type of fish they caught.

Note that fish cannot be caught using [[diamond]]s. Players have to play the mini-game when catching them with lures, or they have to use nets.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Selling fish fillets'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Fish fillet can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 540 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 pieces.
* Making red [[lure]]s or [[Fishing Net|nets]] to catch fish requires no material and does not cost anything. Making other types of lure requires [[voucher]]s.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Using fish fillets'''===
Fish fillets are used to make the following [[products]]:

{{Item Usage|Fish Fillet
|Fish Burger|2|27
|Fish Pie|3|28
|Meat Bucket|3|34 (First Arctic [[Fox]])
|Fish and Chips|2|41
|Frutti di Mare Pizza|1|45
|Fish Soup|2|53
|Sushi Roll|1|56
|Seafood Salad|1|64
|Olive Dip|1|66
|Big Sushi Roll|1|76
|Fish Taco|1|79
|Spicy Fish|1|79
|Canned Fish|2|95
|Fish Skewer|1|96
}}
----
==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|link=Boat|Riverboat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for 6 to 9 fillets per crate, up to a total of 28 per boat.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Recipes ask between 1 and 3 fillets.
* Fillets are so rare that selling them below the maximum price is not recommended.
----

Like all products, it is stored in the [[barn]].

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Extracting gold ore'''===
[[File:Mine.png|150px|left|Mine]]
Gold ore is found in the [[Mine]].

To extract ore, players need one of the following supplies. Each type of supplies gives different numbers of ore, as shown below.

It takes no time to extract ore but the process is randomized: players might get any of the available mine products when using mine supplies, as well as an extra [[diamond]]. Each extracted gold ore gives players 6 [[experience]] points.

{{Clr}}

==='''Selling gold ore'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside Shop]]
* Gold ore can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 216 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 units.
* Buying a supply tool costs between 25 and 126 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

* Gold ore is uncommon enough that selling them at a lower price is not necessary.
* Selling gold ore is not profitable at all. You should always transform it into bars, or even better, [[Jeweler|jewelry]] unless it takes valuable space in your [[barn]].
* [[Boat]] orders never require gold ore.

'''Lamb Chop''' is a type of [[Animal Goods|animal good]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 25. It is added since May 2026 Update.

It is used to make [[Grilled Lamb Skewer|grilled lamb skewers]] and [[Tower Doner Supreme|tower doner supreme]], as well as feed [[:Category:Dogs|dogs]] and [[:Category:Puppies|puppies]]. It is, however, more convenient to use lamb chops to feed these animals as [[bacon]] is required for so many other [[products]].

Like all goods, it is stored in the [[barn]].
{{Clr}}
----

=== '''Collecting Lamb''' ===
[[File:Ready Lamb Cube.png|left|150x150px|Ready Lamb Cube]]
Lamb chops are collected from [[Lamb|lambs]] which have been fed [[Lamb Feed|lamb feed]]. Once fed, [[Lamb|lambs]] need 30 minutes to make another lamb chop.

Collecting one lamb chop gives players 4 {{Infoicon|xp}} points.
{{Clr}}
----

=== '''Selling Lamb Chops''' ===
[[File:Roadside_Shop.png|link=Roadside_Shop|left|150x150px|Roadside Shop]]

* Lamb chops can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 360 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 units.
* A [[lamb]] costs 800 {{Infoicon|coin}} at experience level 25 and 2,300 {{Infoicon|coin}} at experience level 30. Each [[Lamb Pasture|lamb pasture]] costs 500 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
{{Clr}}
----

=== '''Using Lamb Chops''' ===
Lamb chops are used to make the following [[products]]:
{{Item Usage|Lamb Chop
|Grilled Lamb Skewer|2|25
|Tower Doner Supreme|3|58
}}
----

=== '''Boat orders''' ===
[[File:Riverboat.png|link=Boat|left|150x150px|Riverboat]]

* [[Boat]] orders ask for x to x pieces of lamb chop per crate, up to a total of xx per boat.
{{Clr}}
----

=== '''Strategy tips''' ===

* Lamb chop can occasionally be found in the [[Daily Dirt]]. Selling lamb chop at maximum price is recommended as it sells quickly.
* Before you buy dogs take into consideration the fact that you'll have to feed them [[bacon]] or lamb chops. If you have reached [[experience]] level 25, it is more convenient to feed them lamb chops. Below experience level 25, if you don't have enough pigs or don't make enough pig feed, this might be a problem.

'''Peanuts''' is a type of [[Animal Goods|animal good]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 62.



It is used to make [[Honey Peanuts|honey peanuts]], [[Snack Mix|snack mixes]], [[Chocolate Pie|chocolate pies]], [[Peanut Noodles|peanut noodles]], [[Peanut Butter and Jelly Sandwich|peanut butter and jelly sandwiches]], [[Peanut Fudge|peanut fudges]], [[Crunchy Donut|crunchy donuts]], [[Fried Candy Bar|fried candy bars]] and [[Peanut Butter Milkshake|peanut butter milkshakes]].

Unlike the other animal goods, peanuts are stored in the [[silo]].

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Collecting peanuts'''===
[[File:Squirrel.png|150px|left|Squirrel]]
<!--[[File:Beehive Tree Stage 4.png|150px|left|Beehive tree]]-->
Peanuts are collected from entrances in the [[Squirrel House|squirrel house]].

To make one unit of peanuts, [[squirrel]]s need to gather 300 peanut pods from [[Peanut Bush|peanut bushes]] and bring them to the squirrel house. This takes approximately 5 hours if the bushes are close enough. Peanuts can then be immediately collected.

Collecting one unit of peanuts gives players 43 {{Infoicon|xp}} points.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling peanuts'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Peanuts can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 2,340 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 units.
* A [[squirrel]] costs between 4,000 and 7,000 {{Infoicon|coin}} and a [[Peanut Bush|peanut bush]] costs 1,200 {{Infoicon|coin}}.
* The [[Squirrel House|squirrel house]] costs 45,000 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Using peanuts'''===
Peanuts are used to make the following [[products]]:

{{Item Usage|Peanuts|Honey Peanuts|1|63
|Snack Mix|1|64
|Chocolate Pie|1|65
|Peanut Butter Milkshake|1|68
|Peanut Butter and Jelly Sandwich|1|71
|Crunchy Donut|1|82
|Peanut Noodles|1|86
|Fried Candy Bar|1|100
|Peanut Fudge|2|111
}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
<!-- please redo after the upgrade in December 2020--->
*Peanuts were once considered rare in the Daily Dirt. As time goes on, it has now become a very common product you see in the Daily Dirt, so selling in high quantities, or at maximum, may result in slower sales, but still a little faster than the rustic bouquets. (Edit: now possible to find, but not too regularly)
*Although peanuts are now somewhat commonly found in the Daily Dirt, you can always buy them up and make some peanut products with the peanuts you've purchased then sell them back.
*Bear in mind that you can't do the 'buy, make and sell' process all the time as they can also result in slower sales as well.
* Peanuts are never requested in [[boat]] orders.

----
==='''Did you know?'''===
*This is the most expensive crop to this day, costing a whopping 360 coins per bag. It was subsequently reduced to 234 coins in the December 2020 update and still stays as the most expensive crop to this day.
*It may look like a product, but it's stored in the silo instead of the barn.
**This is also the only animal product to do so.
*Originally, it only took 2 hours and 30 minutes for a pair of squirrels to collect the 300 peanut pods necessary to produce 1 peanut.  This was changed 31 August 2020.

{{Clr}}
----

Platinum Ore.title: Platinum Ore
Platinum Ore.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}}
[[File:Platinum Ore.png|200px|left|Platinum ore]]

{{Infobox
 |title = [[Products|Product]]
 |level = 24
 |price = 1 to 32
 |time = Instant
 |source = {{Infoicon|mine|bigger|link=Mine}}
 |xp = 7
 |base = 9
}}

'''Platinum ore''' is a [[Products|product]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 25.

Like all products, it is stored in the [[barn]].

{{Clr}}----
==='''Extracting platinum ore'''===
[[File:Mine.png|150px|left|Mine]]
Platinum ore is found in the [[Mine]].

To extract ore, players need one of the following supplies. Each type of supplies gives different numbers of ore, as shown below.
{| border="0" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="1" style="text-align: center; margin: .5em 0;"
|-
|[[File:Dynamite.png|75px|link=Dynamite|Dynamite]]
|[[File:TNT Barrel.png|75px|link=TNT Barrel|TNT barrel]]
|[[File:Shovel.png|75px|link=Shovel|Shovel]]
|[[File:Pickaxe.png|75px|link=Pickaxe|Pickaxe]]
|-
|'''x2'''
|'''x3'''
|'''x4'''
|'''x5'''
|}

It takes no time to extract ore but the process is randomized: players might get any of the available Mine products when using mine supplies, as well as an extra [[diamond]]. Each extracted platinum ore gives players 7 [[experience]] points.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Selling platinum ore'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|Roadside Shop]]
* Platinum ore can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 324 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 units.
* Buying a supply tool costs between 25 and 126 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Used in'''===
{{Item Usage|Platinum Ore
|Platinum Bar|3|25
}}----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Platinum ore is uncommon enough that selling them at a lower price is not necessary.
* Selling platinum ore is not profitable at all. You should always transform it into bars, or even better, [[Jeweler|jewelry]] unless it takes valuable space in your [[barn]].
* [[Boat]] orders never require platinum ore.
----

indigo.title: Indigo
indigo.wikitext:
{{PageDisplay}}
[[File:Indigo.png|200px|left|Indigo]]

{{Infobox
 |title = [[Crops|Crop]]
 |level = 13
 |price = 1 to 25
 |time = 2 h
 |xp = 5
 |source = {{Infoicon|field|bigger|link=Farm}}
 |base = 7
 |dia = 5
}}
'''Indigo''' is a field [[crops|crop]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 13.

It is used to dye [[Cotton Fabric|cotton fabric]] and [[wool]], make [[Flower Shop|bouquets]] and [[Floral Candle|floral candles]].

Like all crops, they are stored in the [[silo]].

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 380 {{Infoicon|coin}}.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Growing indigo'''===
Indigo is grown in [[Farm|fields]] by planting another indigo plant (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 5 {{Infoicon|xp}} points, and takes 2 hours to mature.
<gallery>
Indigo Stage 1.png
Indigo Stage 2.png
Indigo Stage 3.png
Indigo Stage 4.png
Indigo Stage 5.png
</gallery>
----
==='''Selling indigo'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Indigo can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 252 {{Infoicon|coin}} for 10 units.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Using indigo'''===
Indigo is used to make the following [[products]]:

{{Item Usage|Indigo
|Snowflake Gift|1|17|temp=Snowflake Gift|tempend=20230102
|Blue Woolly Hat|1|19
|Blue Sweater|2|20
|Violet Dress|1|25
|Rustic Bouquet|3|49
|Bright Bouquet|3|65
|Sun Hat|1|74
|Birthday Bouquet|1|92
|Floral Candle|2|95
|Clay Mug|2|99
|Calming Diffuser|3|116
}}
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|link=Boat|Riverboat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for 8 to 19 indigo per crate, up to a total of 68 per boat.
* Each unit of indigo gives players 10 coins and 8 experience points in boat orders.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Recipes only ask for one to three units of indigo so it is not a crop you need to keep large quantities of.
* Indigos are very commonly found in the Daily Dirt and might not get sold quickly if you sell them on max price.
----
==='''Did you know?'''===
* In real life [[wikipedia:Indigofera|indigofera plants]] are used to create [[wikipedia:Indigo_dye|indigo dye]]. In Hay Day, the dyeing making process is skipped.
* Before the October 2017 Update Indigo was the most common crop in Hay Day but after the addition of flower shop and other products the use of Indigo got increased and it started being sold better.
----
